subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: What public Talk idle-timeout contract should OpenClaw support for deactivating inactive Talk sessions after Voice Wake starts them?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public lifecycle and config behavior that can affect all Talk sessions, so automation should not choose the durable product contract alone.

options.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, limits, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and native Talk runtime.

options.title: Scope only to Voice Wake sessions
options.body: Track activation source and auto-deactivate only Talk sessions started from Voice Wake, leaving manually started Talk sessions unchanged.

options.title: Defer to broader voice lifecycle work
options.body: Keep this issue open but wait for a wider Talk and Voice Wake lifecycle design that also covers realtime and mobile behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, limits, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and native Talk runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Talk config policy, gateway protocol shape, and native app lifecycle behavior where steipete has the strongest recent history.
